boundaries: Exactly one primary subject kind is selected. A Product workspace may link zero or more Projects; a Project workspace binds its own Project and does not own other primary Projects.
A Goal or Work record retains its existing Project ownership. Product-wide operations may omit a Project; Project-owned operations require a selected linked Project.
A Project, Goal, Person, Team or model record does not automatically create another workspace.
One Product has one canonical operating home. Co-located Project records do not provision extra homes or duplicate Product identity.
Workspace kind and behavior specialization do not force dedicated execution, separate installation, copied runtime code or new authority.
An unselected native subject identity remains explicitly unselected. A catalog key, folder or passing validation does not admit an identity or grant native permission.
Lab Workspace names the durable scope; runtime instance names execution. Incompatible model/profile revisions require an explicit conversion.

scientific_formal.normative_statement: A Lab Workspace is a durable, versioned operating scope bound to one explicitly selected primary subject of kind Product or Project. A Product workspace keeps its Product records, linked Project coordination and Work in one canonical home. A Project workspace binds one Project and may reference a Product or another declared purpose. It connects eight responsibility areas to an exact operating-model revision, accountable routes, source selections, configuration and lifecycle contracts. Workspace identity, subject identity, physical home, runtime instance and authority grants remain distinct. Shared operations and shared execution are the default; specialization does not require a runtime copy.

notation.meaning: One proposed Lab Workspace record.
Exact parent/local Model Instance Binding, with separately scoped authority.
Selected canonical-home manifests with their own lifecycle/recovery ownership.

testable_conditions: Both Product and Project profiles validate with exactly one matching primary subject kind.
Linked Projects and Goal ownership are explicit and wrong-scope operations refuse.
All eight responsibilities resolve to one canonical Product home.
Multiple workspaces resolve to one shared execution target without code copies.
Legacy Project profiles convert explicitly with unchanged subject and Goal membership.
Native permission gates remain enforced by the existing host.

WellFormed(P) does not imply ConsumerReady(P,u), Admitted(candidate(P)), or MayExecute(u).
scientific_formal.normative_statement: A Definition Pack is an identifiable, version-exact, reviewable bundle that freezes a bounded goal, originating intent, context and named intended use together with the required concept set, exactly one current handling disposition per concept, its disposition payload, exact source and evidence standing, owner routes, relationship scope, unresolved obligations and validation scope. Its handling dispositions are reuse, specialize, propose and open. Reused meanings remain bound to their exact authority; candidate meanings and unresolved obligations remain identifiable. Pack existence, validation or consumer readiness grants no new semantic admission or permission to execute.

notation.meaning: One exact frozen pack revision; this tuple is a semantic contract, not a particular wire schema.
Bounded goal, attributable originating intent, declared context and named consumer with intended use.
Nonempty required concept set, total single-valued current disposition map and matching per-concept payloads.
Exact source/evidence standing, owner routes, scoped relationship records, explicit unresolved obligations and bounded validation results.
References relevant to the named use; unresolved references carry their own visible gaps.
A separate use-specific assessment of blocking obligations; this cannot grant authority.

testable_conditions: Every required concept has exactly one current disposition; duplicate, absent and undeclared dispositions violate the contract.
An unresolved source or owner reference is visible as a scoped gap rather than labeled resolved.
A structurally reviewable pack with a blocking open concept cannot be advertised as ready for its blocked consumer action.
Accepted reuse retains the exact current source authority without fabricating a new admission.
Pack PASS does not establish semantic-owner acceptance or agent action permission.

Define may prepare a consumer input, but consumer suitability, conformance, owner admission and permission remain separate decisions.

scientific_formal.formal_expression: Define(g,i,k,u,E) -> P; Goal(P)=g and OriginatingIntent(P)=i and Context(P)=k and ConsumerUse(P)=u and RequiredConceptCoverage(P) and VisibleResidue(P) and AuthorityEffectOfPreparation(P)=none. Goal or intent revision is explicit and preserves lineage. CapabilityMeaning != CapabilityInstance != MethodBinding != CLIRealization != DefinitionPack != OwnerDecision.
scientific_formal.normative_statement: CyberAlchemy Define is the Lab capability outcome of making the meaning required for one bounded goal and its originating intent explicit for a named consumer. It identifies the declared required concepts, examines existing meanings and their source standing, exposes ambiguous or missing meaning and owner gaps, and records exactly one current disposition—reuse, specialize, propose or open—for every required concept in a reviewable Definition Pack. It preserves unresolved meaning and the intent that motivated the goal. It does not select the consumer solution, admit a Definition, assign an owner or grant execution authority. Its Product Capability instance must separately bind exactly one Product, scope, owner and outcome contract; the CLI and agent are realizations.

notation.meaning: Bounded goal, originating intent, declared context, named consumer/use and selected evidence standing.
One reviewable Definition Pack; its closed contract defines required concept coverage and unresolved obligations.
Each declared required concept receives one current reuse, specialize, propose or open disposition; this is not proof that every relevant concept was discovered.
No new semantic promotion or permission is created by preparation; exact existing meanings retain their separate authority.

testable_conditions: The output goal remains traceable to its originating intent; no implementation convenience silently replaces it.
Every concept declared required in the resulting pack has exactly one handling disposition.
An unanswered question remains visible without a fabricated user answer or semantic-owner decision.
The same capability meaning can have different CLI, chat or other realizations.
A successful Define result cannot imply that an agent may repair production or close an incident.

scientific_formal.normative_statement: A Construction Chain Contract is a version-exact, owner-scoped specialization of the CyberAlchemy Construction Method that selects the ordered dependency chain Definitions, typed Artifacts, business/domain ontology, business-system bridge ontology, authored system-design ontology, AlchLang source and generation. Every required downstream obligation must trace to exact upstream subjects through declared handoffs on one coherent cut; missing required mappings or stale inputs block a claim of conformant generation. Iteration is permitted through explicit successors, but neither a generated graph nor an existing implementation may replace upstream design or manufacture its historical provenance.

scientific_formal.normative_statement: A Construction Stage Handoff is an identifiable, version-exact transfer specification between two adjacent stages of one selected Construction Chain Contract. It binds exact input/output subject revisions and bytes, source standing, scope and owner routes, authored or mechanical transformation, rationale, preservation and coverage obligations, validation evidence and unresolved residue. It grants no authority and cannot equate an ontology representation with its subject or generated output with semantic acceptance. A missing required target blocks downstream conformance; changing an input invalidates the dependent handoff and its transitive results.
